title: Introduction to Programming
description: Foundational programming concepts including variables, control structures, functions, and basic data structures using Python.

title: Linear Algebra
description: Vector spaces, linear transformations, matrices, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, with applications to computer science.

title: Quantum Mechanics
description: Advanced quantum theory including wave functions, operators, quantum states, and applications to atomic and molecular physics.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms
description: Study of fundamental data structures (trees, graphs, hash tables) and algorithms (sorting, searching, graph traversal).

title: Calculus I
description: Introduction to differential calculus including limits, continuity, derivatives, and applications.

title: Machine Learning Foundations
description: Supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, model evaluation, and practical applications using Python and scikit-learn.

title: Web Development Fundamentals
description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript basics, responsive design, and introduction to web frameworks.

title: Real Analysis
description: Rigorous treatment of limits, continuity, differentiation, integration, and sequences of functions.

title: Discrete Mathematics
description: Logic, set theory, graph theory, combinatorics, and applications to computer science.

title: Statistics and Probability
description: Descriptive statistics, probability theory, random variables, distributions, and hypothesis testing.

title: Classical Mechanics
description: Newton's laws, kinematics, dynamics, energy, momentum, and rotational motion.

title: Electromagnetism
description: Electric fields, magnetic fields, Maxwell's equations, and electromagnetic waves.

title: Database Systems
description: Relational databases, SQL, normalization, transactions, query optimization, and NoSQL introduction.

title: Statistical Mechanics
description: Thermodynamic systems, ensembles, partition functions, phase transitions, and quantum statistical mechanics.

title: Artificial Intelligence
description: Search algorithms, knowledge representation, planning, machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision.

title: Computational Physics
description: Numerical methods for solving physics problems, molecular dynamics, Monte Carlo simulations, and scientific computing.

title: Software Engineering
description: Comprehensive study of software development lifecycle including requirements analysis, system design, implementation strategies, testing methodologies, project management, agile development practices, version control systems, continuous integration and deployment, software architecture patterns, design principles, code quality metrics, refactoring techniques, team collaboration tools, and professional software engineering practices in industry contexts.

title: Thermodynamics
description: Laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy, and applications to physical systems.

title: Abstract Algebra
description: Groups, rings, fields, homomorphisms, quotient structures, and applications to number theory and cryptography.
